article.title: A Morning at Home
article.content: My name is Lily. I live with my father and my sister. On school days, I get up at seven. My father makes breakfast. I eat bread and an egg, and my sister has some fruit. We put our books in our bags. The school is near our home, so we walk there together. We leave home at eight. On rainy days, our father takes us to school by car.
article.translation: 我叫莉莉，和爸爸、妹妹住在一起。上学的日子里，我七点起床。爸爸做早饭。我吃面包和一个鸡蛋，妹妹吃一些水果。我们把书放进书包。学校离家很近，所以我们一起走过去。我们八点离开家。下雨时，爸爸开车送我们去学校。

questions.prompt: What does Lily eat for breakfast?
questions.explanation: 文中说“I eat bread and an egg”。吃水果的是妹妹。

questions.prompt: Why do the sisters usually walk to school?
options: The school is near their home
They meet friends on the way
questions.explanation: “The school is near our home, so we walk there together”说明了步行的原因。

questions.prompt: How do they go to school on rainy days?
questions.explanation: 最后一句说，下雨时爸爸开车送她们。
